hero.subtitle: Connect with eco-construction and permaculture projects worldwide. Learn new skills while contributing to sustainable communities.

about.title: Welcome to Ecobilda
about.intro: Ecobilda is dedicated to natural building and permaculture, but above all to human connections. A platform to travel, meet, and learn.
about.mission: Ecobilda links those who build naturally with those eager to travel and learn.

naturalBuilding.title: Natural Building
naturalBuilding.content: Learn by doing. Build ecological and sustainable habitats using local materials like earth, straw, and timber.

permaculture.title: Permaculture
permaculture.content: Create resilient systems. Grow in harmony with nature by observing and mimicking its ecosystems for sustainable abundance.

community.title: Community
community.content: Meet passionate people. Share life moments, knowledge, and meals. The human adventure is at the heart of every project.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple steps to start your eco-building adventure.

step1.title: Browse Projects
step1.desc: Explore eco-construction and permaculture projects around the world. Filter by location, skills, and availability.

step2.title: Apply to Participate
step2.desc: Send a motivation message to the host explaining why you want to join. Show your enthusiasm and willingness to learn.

step3.title: Learn and Contribute
step3.desc: Once accepted, gain hands-on skills while helping build sustainable projects. A life-changing experience awaits.

forHosts.title: Are You a Project Host?
forHosts.desc: Post your eco-construction or permaculture project and find motivated volunteers from around the world. Ecobilda makes it easy to manage applications and communicate with participants.
forHosts.benefit1: Reach a global community of volunteers passionate about sustainability and natural building.
forHosts.benefit2: Manage participation requests easily and chat directly with accepted volunteers.
forHosts.benefit3: It is completely free. No fees, no commissions, no hidden costs.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Yes, Ecobilda is completely free for both volunteers and project hosts. There are no fees, subscriptions, or hidden costs.
faq.q2: What types of projects can I find?
faq.a2: Ecobilda focuses on two main areas: natural building (strawbale, cob, earthen plaster, carpentry, etc.) and permaculture (garden design, composting, harvesting, etc.).
faq.a3: Stay duration is flexible and varies by project. Some last a few days, others several weeks or even months. Each project listing specifies the expected duration.
faq.a4: Not at all! Most projects welcome beginners and provide on-site training. The whole point is to learn by doing alongside experienced hosts.
faq.q5: How does the host accept me?
faq.a5: You send a participation request with a motivation message. The host reviews your profile and message, then accepts or declines. Once accepted, you can chat directly to arrange details.

cta.title: Ready to Start Your Journey?
cta.subtitle: Join our community of eco-builders and permaculture enthusiasts today.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about Ecobilda
faq.cantFindAnswer: Can't find the answer you're looking for? Our support team is here to help.

gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.a1: Ecobilda is a platform connecting volunteers with eco-construction and permaculture projects worldwide. Learn sustainable skills while helping eco-friendly communities.
gettingStarted.q2: How do I create an account?
gettingStarted.a2: Click on "Register" in the top navigation, fill in your details including name, email, date of birth, and password. Once registered, you can start browsing and applying to projects.
gettingStarted.a3: Yes, creating an account and browsing projects is completely free. Some project hosts may have specific requirements or fees, which will be clearly stated in their project description.

forVolunteers.title: For Volunteers
forVolunteers.a1: Use the Projects page to browse all available opportunities. You can filter by location, project type (Permaculture or Natural Building), and required skills.
forVolunteers.q2: What should I bring to a project?
forVolunteers.a2: Each project has different requirements. Check the project details page for specific information about what to bring, accommodation provided, and work expectations.
forVolunteers.a3: Yes! After completing a project, both volunteers and hosts can leave reviews. This helps build trust in our community.

forHosts.title: For Hosts
forHosts.q1: How do I create a project?
forHosts.a1: Once logged in, click on "Create Project" and fill in all the details about your project, including description, location, required skills, and work conditions.
forHosts.q2: How many volunteers can I host?
forHosts.a2: You can specify the maximum number of volunteers when creating your project. You can also set different limits for male and female volunteers if needed.
forHosts.q3: Can I edit my project after publishing?
forHosts.a3: Yes, you can edit your project details at any time from your profile. Make sure to keep the information up-to-date for potential volunteers.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Ecobilda, we are committed to protecting your privacy and personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your information when you use our platform. We comply with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and other applicable data protection laws.

dataCollection.title: 1. Data We Collect
dataCollection.desc: We collect several types of information to provide and improve our services:

accountData.title: Account Information
accountData.desc: When you create an account, we collect your first and last name, email address, date of birth, profile photo (optional), spoken languages, bio/description, country of residence, and skills. If you register via Google OAuth, we receive your name, email, and profile picture from Google.

projectData.title: Project and Activity Data
projectData.desc: We collect project descriptions, photos, locations (address and coordinates), availability dates, participation requests and their status, messages exchanged between users, reviews and ratings, reports and flagged content, and saved searches and favorites.

technicalData.title: Technical Data
technicalData.desc: We automatically collect your IP address, browser type and version, device information, pages visited and time spent on each page, referring website, and cookies and similar technologies (see Cookies section).

dataUse.title: 2. How We Use Your Data
dataUse.desc: We use the collected data for the following purposes:
dataUse.purpose1: To create and manage your account and authenticate your identity.
dataUse.purpose2: To connect volunteers with project hosts and facilitate participation requests.
dataUse.purpose3: To enable communication between users after a participation request is accepted.
dataUse.purpose4: To send transactional notifications (participation updates, new messages, review reminders).
dataUse.purpose5: To maintain platform security, prevent fraud, and enforce our Terms of Service.
dataUse.purpose6: To improve and optimize our platform, features, and user experience.

legalBasis.title: 3. Legal Basis for Processing
legalBasis.desc: We process your personal data based on: (a) your consent, provided when you create an account and accept our terms; (b) the performance of a contract, as processing is necessary to provide our services; (c) our legitimate interests, such as platform security, fraud prevention, and service improvement; (d) legal obligations, when we are required to process data to comply with applicable laws.

sharing.title: 4. Data Sharing
sharing.desc: We may share your data in the following limited circumstances:
sharing.case1: With other users: Your public profile information, project details, and reviews are visible to other platform users. Messages are shared only with conversation participants.
sharing.case2: With service providers: We use third-party services for hosting (Hetzner), email delivery, map services (Mapbox), and authentication (Google OAuth). These providers process data only on our behalf and under strict contractual obligations.
sharing.case3: For legal reasons: We may disclose data if required by law, court order, or government request, or to protect the rights, safety, or property of Ecobilda or its users.
sharing.noSell: We never sell your personal data to third parties for advertising or marketing purposes.

cookies.title: 5. Cookies
cookies.desc: Ecobilda uses essential cookies required for the platform to function (authentication tokens, session management, language preferences). We do not use advertising or tracking cookies. No consent banner is required for strictly necessary cookies under GDPR.

dataProtection.title: 6. Data Security
dataProtection.desc: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data, including encrypted data transmission (HTTPS/TLS), secure password hashing, JWT-based authentication with token expiration, access controls and role-based permissions, and regular security reviews. While we strive to protect your data, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

retention.title: 7. Data Retention
retention.desc: We retain your personal data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide our services. If you delete your account, we will remove your personal data within 30 days, except where retention is required by law or necessary for legitimate business purposes (such as resolving disputes or enforcing our agreements). Messages in conversations may be anonymized rather than deleted to preserve the integrity of the other participant's records. Reviews may be retained in anonymized form.

rights.title: 8. Your Rights
rights.desc: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
rights.access: Right of access: You can request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
rights.rectification: Right to rectification: You can update or correct your data through your profile settings or by contacting us.
rights.erasure: Right to erasure: You can request the deletion of your account and personal data.
rights.portability: Right to data portability: You can request your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
rights.restriction: Right to restriction: You can request that we limit how we process your data in certain circumstances.
rights.objection: Right to object: You can object to data processing based on our legitimate interests.
rights.howTo: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at contact@ecobilda.com. We will respond to your request within 30 days. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

children.title: 9. Children's Privacy
children.desc: Ecobilda is not intended for children under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 18. If we become aware that we have collected personal data from a child under 18 without parental consent, we will take steps to delete that information promptly.

international.title: 10. International Data Transfers
international.desc: Your data is stored on servers located in the European Union (Hetzner, Germany). If data needs to be transferred outside the EU/EEA, we ensure that appropriate safeguards are in place, such as Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission.

changes.title: 11. Changes to This Policy
changes.desc: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes via email or through a prominent notice on the platform. Your continued use of Ecobilda after changes are posted constitutes your acceptance of the updated policy. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.

contact.title: 12. Contact Us
contact.desc: If you have questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at contact@ecobilda.com.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Welcome to Ecobilda. These Terms of Service govern your access to and use of the Ecobilda platform, which connects eco-construction and permaculture project hosts with volunteers. By creating an account or using our services, you agree to be bound by these terms.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.desc: By accessing or using Ecobilda, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you must not use the platform.

description.title: 2. Platform Description
description.desc: Ecobilda is an online platform that facilitates connections between hosts who run eco-construction and permaculture projects and volunteers who wish to learn and contribute. Ecobilda acts solely as an intermediary and is not a party to any agreement made between hosts and volunteers. We do not supervise, direct, or control the projects listed on the platform.

eligibility.title: 3. Eligibility
eligibility.desc: You must be at least 18 years old to create an account on Ecobilda. By registering, you represent and warrant that you meet this age requirement and that the information you provide is accurate and complete. Users under 18 may participate in projects only under the direct supervision of a parent or legal guardian who holds an active Ecobilda account.

accounts.title: 4. User Accounts
accounts.desc: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. You must provide accurate, current, and complete information during registration and keep your profile up to date. You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account. Ecobilda reserves the right to suspend or terminate accounts that contain false or misleading information.

use.title: 5. Acceptable Use
use.desc: When using Ecobilda, you agree to the following rules:
use.rule1: Use the platform only for its intended purpose: connecting hosts and volunteers for eco-construction and permaculture projects.
use.rule2: Provide truthful and accurate information in your profile, project listings, and communications.
use.rule3: Treat all users with respect and refrain from harassment, discrimination, or abusive behavior.
use.rule4: Do not use the platform for commercial solicitation, advertising, or any activity unrelated to skill-sharing and volunteering.
use.rule5: Do not attempt to circumvent platform features, manipulate reviews, create multiple accounts, or engage in any form of fraud.

hosts.title: 6. Host Responsibilities
hosts.desc: Hosts are responsible for providing accurate descriptions of their projects, including the type of work, required skills, accommodation conditions, and availability periods. Hosts must ensure a safe working environment for volunteers and comply with all local laws and regulations applicable to their activities. Hosts agree to accept or decline participation requests in a timely manner and to communicate clearly with accepted volunteers.

volunteers.title: 7. Volunteer Responsibilities
volunteers.desc: Volunteers are responsible for providing accurate information in their participation requests, including their skills, availability, and motivations. Volunteers commit to honoring accepted participation agreements and to performing agreed-upon tasks with reasonable care. Volunteers should inform hosts as early as possible of any changes to their plans. Ecobilda is not an employer; volunteers participate of their own free will and no employment relationship exists between volunteers and hosts or Ecobilda.

content.title: 8. User-Generated Content
content.desc: You retain ownership of content you post on Ecobilda (project descriptions, photos, messages, reviews). By posting content, you grant Ecobilda a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, display, and distribute that content in connection with operating the platform. You are solely responsible for the content you post and warrant that it does not infringe any third-party rights, contain illegal material, or violate these terms.

messaging.title: 9. Messaging and Communication
messaging.desc: The messaging system on Ecobilda is available only after a participation request has been accepted by a host. This measure is designed to prevent spam and ensure meaningful exchanges. Users must not use the messaging system to send unsolicited commercial messages, share inappropriate content, or engage in harassment. Ecobilda reserves the right to monitor messages for compliance with these terms.

reviews.title: 10. Reviews and Ratings
reviews.desc: After a participation experience, both hosts and volunteers may leave reviews. Reviews are published only when both parties have submitted their review or after a 30-day deadline, whichever comes first. This ensures fair and unbiased feedback. Reviews must be honest, relevant to the experience, and respectful. Ecobilda reserves the right to remove reviews that violate these guidelines or that are found to be fraudulent.

ip.title: 11. Intellectual Property
ip.desc: The Ecobilda name, logo, website design, and all associated content, software, and technology are the property of Ecobilda and are protected by intellectual property laws. You may not copy, modify, distribute, or create derivative works based on any Ecobilda materials without our prior written consent.

termination.title: 12. Account Termination
termination.desc: You may delete your account at any time through your account settings. Ecobilda reserves the right to suspend or permanently terminate accounts that violate these terms, engage in fraudulent activity, or are reported for inappropriate behavior, after investigation. Upon termination, your right to use the platform ceases immediately. We may retain certain data as required by law or for legitimate business purposes.

liability.title: 13. Limitation of Liability
liability.desc: Ecobilda serves as a platform connecting hosts and volunteers and does not guarantee the quality, safety, or legality of projects listed. We are not responsible for the conduct of users, the accuracy of project listings, or any damages resulting from interactions between users. Ecobilda is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis. To the maximum extent permitted by law, Ecobilda disclaims all warranties and shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from your use of the platform.

indemnification.title: 14. Indemnification
indemnification.desc: You agree to indemnify and hold harmless Ecobilda, its founders, employees, and agents from any claims, damages, losses, or expenses (including legal fees) arising from your use of the platform, your violation of these terms, or your violation of any third-party rights.

modifications.title: 15. Modifications to Terms
modifications.desc: Ecobilda reserves the right to modify these Terms of Service at any time. We will notify users of significant changes via email or through a notice on the platform. Your continued use of the platform after such changes constitutes your acceptance of the modified terms. We encourage you to review these terms periodically.

governing.desc: These Terms of Service are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Belgium. Any disputes arising from or relating to these terms or your use of the platform shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Brussels, Belgium.
